<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-w46-claude-fable-5-2-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-w46/claude-fable-5-2-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-11-10" data-aixpm-title="Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2." markdown>

**Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2.** The models are up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions and cheaper, at $8 and $40 per million input and output tokens. In one experiment, Fable 5.2 coordinated over 1,000 subagents for eight days to build a working prototype operating system. Anthropic still recommends Opus 5.5 as the daily driver for most coding and knowledge tasks; the benchmarks are the vendor's own. [Anthropic, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-10-gpt-6-1-terra-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-10/gpt-6-1-terra-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-10-31" data-aixpm-title="OpenAI&#x27;s GPT-6.1 Terra targets everyday computer use at half the API price." markdown>

**OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra targets everyday computer use at half the API price.** The model is built for work such as filling out forms or entering invoice details into accounting software. OpenAI says it completes tasks over three times faster than GPT-6 Astra, at standard API prices 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra; the benchmarks are OpenAI's own. [OpenAI, 26 Oct 2026](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-1-terra/)

**Nvidia releases open models built to run agents locally.** The three Nemotron models include the 120-billion-parameter Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, which organisations can fine-tune on proprietary data, and two smaller Bolt models for PCs and edge devices, one fitting in a 24GB memory footprint. **Anthropic launched the Claude 5.5 family at lower prices.** Opus 5.5 is presented as matching Claude Fable 5.1 on most work while costing 40% less to run than Opus 5. Sonnet 5.5 is said to run 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5 and is positioned for everyday tasks, including polished documents, slides and spreadsheets. Performance claims are the vendor's own. **Google's Gemini 4 Argon arrives, at first only for vetted cyber defenders.** Google describes Argon as built for long-horizon professional tasks, with a 1-million-token limit, and strong at coding, financial research and legal drafting. It is rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program before wider release. [Google, 30 Sep 2026](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-argon/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-gemini-3-7-flash-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/gemini-3-7-flash-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash at half its predecessor&#x27;s launch price." markdown>

**Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash at half its predecessor's launch price.** Arriving three weeks after 3.6 Flash, it costs $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens until the end of 2026. Google reports gains on complex document processing (34.0% vs 22.0% on GDP.pdf) and business-workflow automation (30.4% vs 17.0% on AutomationBench); these are its own benchmarks. [9to5Google, 13 Aug 2026](https://9to5google.com/2026/08/13/gemini-3-7-flash-launch/)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-meta-muse-glimmer-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/meta-muse-glimmer-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="Meta released Muse Glimmer, an open-weight agent model for consumer hardware." markdown>

**Meta released Muse Glimmer, an open-weight agent model for consumer hardware.** The 30-billion-parameter model is built for local, always-on agents that plan, call tools and check their own results; Nvidia says it runs on a PC with a single consumer GPU and can work on local files. Mark Zuckerberg says the weights of the larger Muse Spark 1.2 will follow. [Campus Technology, 26 Aug 2026](https://campustechnology.com/articles/2026/08/26/meta-releases-muse-glimmer-an-open-weight-ai-model-designed-to-run-on-consumer-hardware.aspx)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-08-openai-paused-astra" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-08/openai-paused-astra/" data-aixpm-date="2026-08-31" data-aixpm-title="OpenAI paused work on its next model, Astra, over cyber capabilities." markdown>

**OpenAI paused work on its next model, Astra, over cyber capabilities.** Less than a week after presenting Astra's scientific results, OpenAI said it "cannot rule out critical cyber capabilities" under its Preparedness Framework and was pausing internal activities on the model. Its previous high-end model, GPT-5.6 Sol, had only reached the "high" threshold. [PCWorld, 7 Aug 2026](https://www.pcworld.com/article/3208734/openai-pumps-the-brakes-on-new-astra-model-over-cybersecurity-concerns.html)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-frontier-models-government-gating" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/frontier-models-government-gating/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="GPT-5.6 and Claude Fable 5 reached general availability after government-gated launches." markdown>

**GPT-5.6 and Claude Fable 5 reached general availability after government-gated launches.** OpenAI said it would publicly release GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna about two weeks after limiting them to a "small group of trusted partners" at the US government's request. Anthropic restored Claude Fable 5 worldwide on 1 July, after export controls imposed on 12 June had forced it to suspend the model for all users. A June executive order asks developers to voluntarily provide cutting-edge models for government assessment ahead of a full release. [CNBC, 8 Jul 2026](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/openai-expanding-gpt-5point6-ai-model-release-ending-government-limits.html) · [Anthropic, 30 Jun 2026](https://www.anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-claude-opus-5-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/claude-opus-5-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, close to its top model at half the price." markdown>

**Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, close to its top model at half the price.** Released on 24 July at the same cost as Opus 4.8, it "comes close to the frontier intelligence of Claude Fable 5 at half the price" and becomes the default model on Claude Max. Anthropic reports a pass rate around 1.5 times the next-best model on Zapier AutomationBench, which measures whether models complete business tasks from start to finish; the benchmark selection is the vendor's own. [Anthropic, 24 Jul 2026](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-5)

<div class="aixpm-item" id="2026-07-gemini-3-6-flash-release" data-aixpm-key="/editions/2026-07/gemini-3-6-flash-release/" data-aixpm-date="2026-07-31" data-aixpm-title="Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, cheaper than 3.5 Flash and aimed at agents run at scale." markdown>

**Google released Gemini 3.6 Flash, cheaper than 3.5 Flash and aimed at agents run at scale.** Priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, it uses 17% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash on the Artificial Analysis Index, according to Google, and makes computer use a built-in tool in the Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise. It shipped with 3.5 Flash-Lite and a security-focused 3.5 Flash Cyber; the performance figures are those cited by Google. [Google, 21 Jul 2026](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-3-6-flash-3-5-flash-lite-3-5-flash-cyber/)
